scope: All enabled dialogue branches in Boolean entry contexts; production effects, variants and choice history; repetition against every earlier spoken line on a path. Equivalent state/history/heard-utterance sets merge; silent response-menu returns add no speech.

earlier.speaker: Mara
earlier.text: The tower's burning again. Would you check on the clerk? I heard glass breaking in her office. The door is beside the tower.

limitations: Entry contexts are logical candidates, including impossible world states; witness flags are assumptions, not physical reachability proof.
Numeric scores start at authored defaults. Numeric-gated conversations mark the report incomplete.
Phrase matches are review warnings, not semantic equivalence or automatic rewrite decisions. Short acknowledgements and intentional replays of the same authored line are excluded.
Coverage is within conversations and authored cutscene sequences, not arbitrary ordering of separate world interactions. All earlier lines within each conversation or sequence are compared.
